questions.page: /public-service-pay-scales/aps/{aps-3..el2}/ (FAQ 'How much super does an APS 6 get?')
claims: On the {grade} threshold minimum of {min}, 15.4% is {min * 0.154} a year on top of salary.
whys: The first sentence reads the rate from APS_SUPER_RATE, but the second sentence types '15.4%' and multiplies by a literal 0.154. If APS.superannuation.rate changes, the two sentences in this answer will disagree. The same literal 0.154 is used in modules/guide/aps-grade-page.tsx line 172.

The 12% Superannuation Guarantee rate is typed as a literal in the same answer that reads APS_SUPER_RATE from code. It should come from the SUPER_GUARANTEE constant, the one state-level-page.tsx already uses, so this text cannot fall out of step with the rate.
reviewerNotes: Writer's question confirmed. The super FAQ answer reads ${APS_SUPER_RATE}% in the first sentence but types '15.4%' and a literal 0.154 in the second. It also types '12% Superannuation Guarantee' instead of reading the SG constant. If either constant changes, the answer will contradict itself.

claims: The Clerk Grade 9/10 FAQ dates the rates 'From 1 July 2026', while the 5/6 FAQ and the schedule say 'the first full pay period on or after 1 July 2026'.
whys: The effective date is worded two ways on one page, and the Crown award's operative date is the first full pay period on or after 1 July 2026. Wording consistency should be checked against the source (not changed in this pass).

claims: Bands 4 to 8 of the General Stream have a second range.
whys: The data contradicts this. Band 1 has Range 2 pay points (Range 2 Level 2, 4 and 5 at lines 98-100), and the Band 1 summary at line 93 says 'five salary points across two ranges'. Either Band 1 belongs in the sentence, or the sentence means only bands where you reach Range 2 through an advancement assessment point. The locked General Stream description at line 87 says the same 'Bands 4 to 8'.
constants: TAS.progression[1] and the tas-general stream description in lib/data/public-service-pay/tas.ts
reviewerNotes: I confirmed the writer's fact question against the data. The Band 1 pay points include Range 2 Level 2, 4 and 5 (tas.ts lines 99-101), but progression[1] at line 330 and the stream description at line 87 say only 'Bands 4 to 8' have a second range.

claims: Band 9 summary: 'has been the top General Stream band since Band 10 was removed on 1 December 2025'.
whys: Elsewhere the removal is dated 'from the first full pay period on or after 1 December 2025' (line 87, clause 15, Band 10 FAQ). This summary gives a calendar date, which may not be the effective date. The wording was there before this pass.
constants: tas.ts General Stream Band 9 summary vs the tas-general stream description
